categories.main_business_segments: China Overseas Grand Oceans Group Ltd. primarily operates in two segments: property development and commercial property operations. The property development segment focuses on developing and selling residential and commercial properties mainly in second- and third-tier cities in Mainland China. The commercial property operations segment involves property rentals, hotel operations, and other commercial property activities, generating stable recurring income.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group emphasizes standardized building layouts, room modules, and unit components to improve operational efficiency and product quality. It has developed residential product standards and cost benchmarks, including interior decoration standardization covering storage, lighting, smart technology, MEP, hardware materials, and precision work. The Group also leverages green building technologies through its subsidiary COGO Low Carbon Building Technology Co., Ltd., focusing on carbon audits and ESG platform development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves residential property buyers primarily in mid-tier cities across Mainland China, targeting customers seeking affordable and upgraded housing. It also caters to commercial tenants through its office buildings, shopping malls, hotels, and long-term leased apartments. The Group's customers include end-users of residential properties and commercial tenants in various cities where it operates.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates extensively across Mainland China, with a land bank and projects distributed in 32 cities including Hefei, Shantou, Lanzhou, Weifang, Yangzhou, Hohhot, Yinchuan, Nantong, Taizhou, Jinhua, Nanning, and others. It holds properties and conducts operations mainly in second- and third-tier cities, with no significant revenue derived from Hong Kong or other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Overseas Grand Oceans Group Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain. It is engaged in property development (construction and sales) and commercial property management and leasing, focusing on delivering finished residential and commercial properties to end customers and tenants.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic focus includes expanding its presence in mid-tier cities with a '3P' investing strategy targeting prominent cities, prime neighborhoods, and popular property types. It prioritizes product standardization for low cost, high quality, and fast delivery. The Group also emphasizes sustainable development, carbon neutrality, and ESG initiatives, supported by its subsidiary specializing in low carbon building technology. Innovation in green financing and smart home technologies are key R&D directions.
categories.revenue_model: The Group generates revenue mainly through the sale of developed residential and commercial properties (recognized at point in time). It also earns recurring income from commercial property rentals, hotel operations, and other commercial activities (recognized over time). Additional income sources include interest income and gains from property disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group is positioned as a leading mid-tier city property developer in Mainland China, ranking 18th in the industry with improved market share and sales performance. It competes with other major developers focusing on top-tier cities but leverages its competitive edge in mid-tier markets. Its strong brand, state-owned enterprise backing, and operational efficiency differentiate it from peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, the Group reported revenue of RMB45.9 billion, a decrease of 18.6% year-on-year, and profit attributable to owners of RMB954 million, down 58.5%. The Group maintains a sizable land bank of approximately 13.78 million sq.m. gross floor area and a net gearing ratio of 33.1%, improved from 46.0% in 2023. Despite market challenges, the Group sustains positive operating cash flow and a healthy financial position with cash and bank balances exceeding RMB27 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes high-quality, standardized, and affordable residential products tailored to mid-tier city markets, supported by a strong brand reputation and customer satisfaction rating of 94%. Its focus on 'Low Cost, High Quality, Fast Delivery' and green building technologies provides competitive differentiation. The Group's robust delivery record, efficient cash flow management, and ESG leadership further enhance its value proposition to customers and investors.
